hatred.line: I met another man who was wounded in hatred
stanza: Oh, what did you meet, my blue-eyed son?
And who did you meet, my darling young one?
I met a young child beside a dead pony
I met a white man who walked a black dog
I met a young woman, her body was burning
I met a young girl, she gave me a rainbow
I met one man who was wounded in love
I met another man who was wounded in hatred

hatred.line: I was trapped in the hatred
hatred.linePrev: And then I gained all the weight back
hatred.lineNext: And your life seemed so awesome

stanza: As some warn victory, some downfall
Can be seen in the eyes of those that call
To make all that should be killed to crawl
While others say don't hate nothing at all
